subject: prd/local-git-codehost
statement: Remove the repository-ID ref and cross-origin receipt guarantee. A fresh clone of its configured origin can still check stored record and Git-object consistency; a copy preserving refs and objects may reuse those records, and verification must state that it does not prove repository identity.
rationale: The single-operator local route needs to validate the configured origin's proposal, head, target, and landing, but cannot meaningfully authenticate a distinct origin under the accepted shared-account policy.
